name: Chile Shipping
author: Craft Art

sections.description:
Chile Shipping helps Chilean stores using WooCommerce configure manual shipping rates by commune and by courier.

The plugin adds Chilean regions to WooCommerce, improves the region and commune labels in checkout, and provides a WooCommerce shipping method that calculates shipping based on the customer’s commune.

Main features:

  • Chilean regions and communes catalog.
  • Manual shipping rates by commune.
  • Chilexpress, Starken and Bluexpress as configurable courier options.
  • Custom couriers for local delivery or other shipping providers.
  • Manual shipping rates by courier and commune.
  • Separate checkout rates for each courier with a configured price.
  • Optional global free shipping threshold.
  • Optional free shipping threshold by courier.
  • Checkout labels for Región and Comuna.

This plugin works locally and does not send site data to external servers.

A separate commercial plugin, Chile Shipping PRO, is available from CraftArt. That commercial plugin is distributed outside WordPress.org and is not included in this package.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/chile-shipping-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Chile Shipping and configure commune rates, courier rates, or both.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping > Shipping zones and add the Chile Shipping method to the desired zone.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an external API?

No. This version works locally with manually configured rates.

Does this plugin send data to CraftArt or other external servers?

No. This version does not send site, store, customer, order, or usage data to external servers.

Can I configure different rates by courier?

Yes. You can configure different manual rates for Chilexpress, Starken, Bluexpress and custom couriers by commune.

Can each courier have its own free shipping threshold?

Yes. Each courier can have an optional minimum subtotal for free shipping.

  • Improves the checkout commune selector so it visually matches the region selector more closely.
  • Adds spacing between shipping method radio buttons and courier names in checkout.

1.6.3

  • Adds support for WooCommerce Checkout Block commune selection by region.
  • Adds Store API validation for Chile region/commune combinations.

1.6.2

  • Changed the checkout Comuna field from free text to a selector.
  • Filtered commune options by the selected Región on billing and shipping addresses.
  • Added validation to prevent invalid Región/Comuna combinations at checkout.

1.6.1

  • Improved CraftArt Suite detection so the bundled fallback does not create a duplicate Suite menu when the real Suite is installed.
  • Grouped commune-rate tables by region with collapsible sections.
  • Grouped courier-rate tables by courier and region with collapsible sections.
  • Preserved tariff values for newly created custom couriers during the same save cycle.
  • Reduced submitted empty tariff fields to avoid large form truncation on servers with default PHP input limits.

1.6.0

  • Prepared the free plugin as the required base for a separate PRO add-on.
  • Added extension hooks for admin tabs, admin panels, settings registration, assets and shipping-rate calculation.
  • Prefixed the bundled Suite UI bridge for better WordPress.org compatibility.
  • Kept the free plugin local-only, with no commercial license checks or automatic remote requests.

1.5.53

  • Reduced readme tags to the WordPress.org recommended maximum of five tags.

1.5.52

  • Simplified the commercial information panel to avoid any confusion with locked built-in features.
  • Removed premium feature names from the WordPress.org package copy.
  • Confirmed there are no commercial access checks, external update checks, or automatic remote requests.

1.5.51

  • Added a local-only admin information panel with a purchase link for the separate Chile Shipping PRO plugin.
  • Added a plugin action link to learn more about the separate premium plugin.
  • Kept premium functionality outside the WordPress.org package and avoided external update checks or automatic data transmission.

1.5.50

  • Restored the original Chile Shipping admin visual style with tabs, cards, metrics, quick actions and a sticky save bar.
  • Kept the WordPress.org build local-only and limited to the approved free feature set.

1.5.49

  • Added built-in courier options for Chilexpress, Starken and Bluexpress.
  • Added custom couriers.
  • Added manual courier rates by commune.
  • Added optional free shipping thresholds by courier.
  • Kept the plugin local-only, without external service calls.

1.5.48

  • Local WordPress.org build with Chile region/commune catalog, manual commune rates, basic checkout labels, and one WooCommerce shipping method.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
